protocol.required_durability: independent_append-only authority commits event and signed receipt before acknowledgement

cases.scenario: Equivalent RFC 8785 canonical objects produce identical event hashes regardless of source key order.
cases.expected: PASS; hashes match.

cases.scenario: Duplicate JSON keys, invalid UTF-8, invalid numeric forms and non-canonical payloads are submitted.
cases.expected: REJECT; no event or sequence is allocated.

cases.scenario: A receipt is verified with the pinned Ed25519 public key and then one signed field is modified.
cases.expected: Original verifies; modified receipt fails signature/hash verification.

cases.scenario: A valid receipt from another stream, tenant, election or snapshot is substituted.
cases.expected: REJECT; scope binding mismatch.

cases.scenario: Append first prepared event to an empty stream.
cases.expected: Durable receipt is returned at sequence 1 with zero/genesis previous hash.

cases.scenario: Append reconciled event with exact current sequence and previous receipt hash.
cases.expected: Durable receipt at previous sequence plus one; previous hash links to prior receipt.

cases.scenario: Append event with stale expected sequence or stale previous receipt hash.
cases.expected: CONFLICT; no sequence allocation and no append.

cases.scenario: Two concurrent requests append different events to the same expected head.
cases.expected: Exactly one succeeds; the other receives conflict; no duplicate sequence or fork.

cases.scenario: Retry byte-identical request with same idempotency key after response timeout.
cases.expected: Original receipt returned byte-for-byte; no second event.

cases.scenario: Reuse an idempotency key with a different event body/hash.
cases.expected: REJECT and security alert; no append.

cases.scenario: Simulate service crash before durable commit and after durable commit but before response.
cases.expected: Before commit: retry appends once. After commit: retry returns same receipt. No acknowledged event is lost.

cases.scenario: Untrusted workload, expired workload identity, wrong audience or missing mTLS identity submits append.
cases.expected: 401/403; no append.

cases.scenario: Authenticated ARNA workload attempts to append to a stream outside its tenant/election scope.
cases.expected: 403; no append; security audit record emitted.

cases.scenario: Caller attempts to choose sequence, receipt ID, receipt timestamp, previous hash or signing key ID.
cases.expected: REJECT unknown/forbidden fields; server-owned values cannot be caller-controlled.

cases.scenario: Submit a fresh random 256-bit nonce for current-head challenge.
cases.expected: Signed response echoes exact nonce and current stream head.

cases.scenario: Replay a previously valid signed head response against a new nonce.
cases.expected: REJECT; nonce mismatch.

cases.scenario: Submit expired, reused or malformed nonce.
cases.expected: REJECT; no currentness assertion.

cases.scenario: Return signed head with timestamp outside configured clock-skew/freshness policy.
cases.expected: REJECT; fail closed.

cases.scenario: Restore ARNA database to a backup that predates one or more externally acknowledged events.
cases.expected: Fresh external head is ahead of local state; voting-open blocked; stream quarantined for reconciliation.

cases.scenario: Delete local receipt and outbox acknowledgement rows while external stream remains intact.
cases.expected: Signed external history rebuilds local receipt projection; no event is re-signed or duplicated.

cases.scenario: Modify local snapshot, HMAC attestation, receipt cache or sequence while external head is unchanged.
cases.expected: Local/external event commitment mismatch; fail closed and alert.

cases.scenario: Local database claims a later event than external authority has acknowledged.
cases.expected: Fail closed; do not trust local event or cached receipt.

cases.scenario: External stream contains a gap, broken previous hash or invalid signature during recovery.
cases.expected: Quarantine stream; no automatic repair or overwrite.

cases.scenario: Inspect receipt signing private key from application runtime, service database, logs, backups and CI.
cases.expected: Private key is non-exportable and absent from all inspected locations; KMS/HSM audit evidence exists.

cases.scenario: Rotate signing key after publishing new trust bundle; verify old and new receipts.
cases.expected: New receipts use new key; old receipts remain verifiable with verify-only old public key.

cases.scenario: Revoke a compromised signing key and submit a receipt signed by it.
cases.expected: New receipt rejected; affected streams placed on security hold; historical verification follows explicit compromise policy.

cases.scenario: Attempt key rotation, revocation and export using one operator identity without required second approver.
cases.expected: Denied; dual-control and immutable audit evidence recorded.

cases.scenario: Attempt to delete, overwrite or shorten retention for archived receipt/checkpoint objects using receipt-service operator credentials.
cases.expected: Denied by separate account and WORM retention controls.

cases.scenario: Modify or omit a receipt in an exported archive batch.
cases.expected: Independent verifier detects hash-chain/checkpoint mismatch.

cases.scenario: Restore receipt service database from an older backup while archive/checkpoint has a newer signed head.
cases.expected: Restore is rejected or quarantined until independently reconciled to latest external checkpoint.

cases.scenario: Verify archive replicas, retention lock, legal hold and access logs from separate custodian account.
cases.expected: Evidence proves independent account, approved retention, immutable audit and successful restore test.

cases.scenario: Receipt service is unavailable during prepare/reconcile/freeze append.
cases.expected: Local event remains anchor_pending; retries are idempotent; no anchored claim.

cases.scenario: Receipt service is unavailable or head challenge fails when voting is about to open.
cases.expected: Voting-open blocked; no cached-head fallback.

cases.scenario: Restore receipt authority and archive from disaster-recovery backups.
cases.expected: Signed latest checkpoint and all acknowledged receipts verify; approved RPO/RTO met.

cases.scenario: Generate expected-head conflict, invalid signature, nonce replay and archive mismatch.
cases.expected: Security alerts identify stream, event, reason and correlation ID without exposing voter PII or secret material.

cases.scenario: Auditor verifies exported receipt chain using independently obtained trust bundle.
cases.expected: Auditor can validate signatures, sequence continuity, stream scope and current signed checkpoint read-only.

cases.scenario: Inspect production-readiness evidence for legal retention, service SLA, freshness limit, clock skew, RPO/RTO, residency, owners and incident process.
cases.expected: All values and owners explicitly approved; no placeholder or inferred value.

exit_criteria: Every case passes on exact implementation commit.
End-to-end cases execute against a separately operated staging receipt authority; mocks alone do not satisfy acceptance.
KMS/HSM non-exportability, policy separation and audit evidence are independently inspected.
WORM retention and independent archive restore are demonstrated.
A database rollback simulation proves fresh external-head mismatch blocks voting-open.
Independent security review accepts threat model and residual risks.
Legal retention, data residency, service availability, freshness, clock-skew, RPO/RTO and operational ownership are approved.

execution_record.not_run: ALL — protocol/service infrastructure is not implemented or provisioned.
